cards.title: Form a new Task Force
cards.text: Form a new Task Force from ships in the same Sea Zone.

cards.title: Move ships in a Task Force
cards.text: Move all ships in a TF together per the movement rules. Cost is 1 OPS per Task Force activation. Bad weather may halt surface movement.

cards.title: Fire missiles with TF
cards.text: Resolve missile attacks. Automatic vs facilities; may require a detection roll vs other TFs.

cards.title: ASW in current zone (instead of moving)
cards.text: Instead of moving, a Task Force may conduct Anti-Submarine Warfare in its current zone.

cards.title: Prepare/resolve Amphibious Landing
cards.text: Mark a TF with the 'Amphibious Landing' marker, then resolve the landing next time the TF is activated (TF cannot move on the landing resolution).

cards.title: Submarine move
cards.text: Diesels move 1 Sea Zone, Nuclear submarines move 2. A Soviet SSBN may take a non-diesel sub with it for no extra cost (must start together).

cards.title: Submarine moves and attacks a TF
cards.text: Move into the TF's zone, then perform a torpedo attack on the Task Force.

cards.title: Submarine moves and detects
cards.text: Move into a zone with an unspent enemy TF and attempt to detect it, improving the detection level.

cards.title: Submarine goes On Patrol
cards.text: Place the submarine in On Patrol status so it can react to enemy units moving into or through its zone.

cards.title: Nuclear sub fires missiles from up to 3 zones
cards.text: A nuclear sub may fire missiles from up to 3 zones away. 2-3 subs may coordinate to combine attacks on the same zone and perform a missile attack.

cards.title: Maritime Patrol flies and attacks or detects
cards.text: If a detection is placed or upgraded, active player may attack the detected TF.

cards.title: MP or fighter goes On Patrol
cards.text: Place an air unit On Patrol to react to enemy movement.

cards.title: Air Strike
cards.text: Strike units fly an air strike. Fighters and tankers may fly for free and fighters may escort part-way.

cards.title: Repair a facility
cards.text: Remove the air-marker. Requires a 6+ if undamaged facility, otherwise 7+.

cards.title: Move ships between TFs
cards.text: De-mine a port. Roll if 1 if undamaged facility, otherwise 7+.

cards.title: Launch or move a RORSAT
cards.text: Destroyed on roll of a 1. Cannot stack until 4 aloft.

cards.title: Pass
cards.text: If you have less than 3 cards in hand, draw a card.
